run_pretraining_vicregl: run VICRegL self-supervised pretraining on ImageNet with configurable backbone and loss coefficients
evaluate_vicregl_model: evaluate a trained VICRegL model on validation data with online classification accuracy metrics
build_vicregl_model: build a VICRegL model with ConvNeXt or ResNet backbone, projector, and maps projector for self-supervised learning
compute_vicreg_loss: compute VICReg loss with invariance, variance, and covariance terms for contrastive representation learning
find_nearest_neighbors_maps: find nearest neighbors between feature maps using L2 distance or spatial location matching
